name: remote-screen
title: Remote Screen
description:
Mirror the printer's on-device touchscreen to a browser. Low-overhead framebuffer capture, no UI changes on the device side.

The screen also appears as a tile inside Fluidd and Mainsail, alongside your cameras, with no manual setup: the plugin registers the mirror as a Moonraker [webcam] iframe entry sized for the U1's 480:320 display. You pick the name it shows under when you install it.
tagline: Stream your printer's framebuffer as MJPEG.
author: bespoked
